content.text:
Add per-widget overlay URLs so OBS can isolate alerts from win/loss result

- Overlay stream carries all widgets' frames; new `?w=alerts`/`?w=result`
  query param filters a Browser Source to one widget, letting OBS place
  the alert corner and full-screen result separately
- Settings/dashboard now expose one URL per widget instead of one shared
  overlay URL; sidebar widget list is generated from a single WIDGETS
  source of truth
- Editors arm live preview only on user interaction (edit or Replay)
  so opening the page no longer fires a phantom alert
